subject: Fire Chief Civil Service Exemption Proposal
overview: The Council referred a controversial proposal to exempt the Fire Chief from civil service law to committee following intense debate and public opposition from the fire union. The body also approved a major affordable housing redevelopment at Walkling Court and authorized several Community Preservation Act (CPA) project appropriations.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved meeting records from February 6, 2024, a laundry license, the March Presidential Primary warrant, and state-enabled property tax exemptions for qualifying veterans.

items.title: Exempting Fire Chief Position from Civil Service Law
items.summary: The Council referred a request for special legislation to remove the Fire Chief position from civil service law to the Committee of the Whole after significant debate regarding labor relations and a recent alleged sick-out. Firefighters and union representatives testified that the change would undermine merit-based promotion and constituted political retaliation.

items.title: FY24 Community Preservation Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved ten appropriations totaling over $1.1 million for projects including legal services for homelessness prevention, cemetery road studies and restorations, and park resurfacing.

items.title: Walkling Court Redevelopment Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit and site plan review for the Medford Housing Authority to demolish existing structures and construct 238 units of affordable senior and family housing. The approval included a $50,000 mitigation condition for tree planting and adopted recommendations from the Community Development Board.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Adopted reports from committees covering licensing for signage, city communication strategies, a proposed warming center, rent stabilization home rule research, and charter review timelines.

items.title: Vegetation Overgrowth Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a resolution to discuss creating an ordinance to enforce the removal of private vegetation obstructing public sidewalks to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee.

items.title: Real Estate Transfer Fee Home Rule Petition
items.summary: Tabled a resolution to develop a home rule petition for a local real estate transfer fee until the next regular meeting.

items.title: Housing Stability Notification Ordinance Evaluation
items.summary: Referred a discussion on the implementation and enforcement status of the 2022 Housing Stability Notification Ordinance to the Planning and Permitting Committee.

items.title: FY2025 Budget Process Schedule
items.summary: Approved a resolution establishing an early budget review schedule for the 2025 fiscal year and requested a list of municipal positions currently funded by ARPA grants.
